text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (March 25, 2024) for 489-491 Brimley Road.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Rescinded the Property Standards Order (March 25, 2024) for 489-491 Brimley Road, Folder Number: 24 126194 PRS 00 IV. 2. Directed the Appellant to continue to work with Municipal Licensing and Standards to ensure that any further complaints regarding the visual impact of nuisances are addressed accordingly.
